title: 巴德·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 三孔浅色面具被白色鬃须围绕，红褐长袍保留厚实轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Bard is a celestial traveler with a large pale mask showing three dark apertures, a flowing white mane and beard, short solid limbs, and substantial red-brown robes. Preserve his unusual mask, curved golden head ornaments, and circular waist silhouette rather than normal human anatomy. His brass musical horn hangs inactive beside the body, accompanied by several separate golden meeps with simple spirit forms.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: russet, mask ivory, gold, cosmic blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
